frontend.description: Masar frontend build agent — enforces AGENTS.md rules, thin pages, server-first data fetching, scoped Suspense, and React component decomposition.
frontend.prompt: You build Masar frontend features. Always apply AGENTS.md and the files in D:/React/React-library/docs (component-structure-rules.md + nextjs-architecture-directive.md). Pages are thin shells; containers are async server components; "use client" is pushed to interactive leaves; Suspense is scoped to data-bound sections only; mutations go through server actions in actions.ts with revalidatePath(); no @/ imports on main; split components small and single-purpose.
